org.note: A made-up metal fabricator. Every name, request and number here is invented.

ladder.name: Observe
ladder.blurb: Reads and reports. Cannot change anything.

ladder.name: Draft
ladder.blurb: Prepares the work. A person sends it.

ladder.name: Act with approval
ladder.blurb: Does routine work in its own lane, and stops at a gate for anything that crosses a limit or leaves the building.

agents.name: Queue Triage
agents.since: Moved up after 3 weeks at Draft with no corrections
may: Sort incoming requests by type and urgency
Route them to the owning team using the routing table
maynot: Close, merge or reassign outside the routing table

agents.name: Approvals Chaser
agents.since: Kept at Draft: anything it writes gets read by a person
may: Find requests stalled waiting on an approver
Draft reminder messages for a person to send
maynot: Share internal-only documents with anyone outside the company

agents.name: Vendor Follow-up
agents.since: Started 4 days ago: no record yet
may: Read purchase orders and vendor email
Report overdue deliveries to the supervisor

queue.title: Vendor Kessler: bar stock 6 days late

script.text: Picking up 3 unrouted requests. Routing table loaded.
New starter laptop and badge goes to IT Services. An exact match in the routing table.
script.detail: Routing inside the table is this agent's own lane, so it does it without asking and logs it.

script.text: Coolant disposal pickup goes to Facilities. Matches the table entry for waste and environmental.
Press brake #3 calibration is 12 days old and still unrouted. Flagged.
script.detail: The routing table has no entry for calibration work. Its charter forbids routing outside the table, so it flags instead of guessing.

NF-2841: Flagged: 12 days old, no routing rule

script.text: Proposing a routing rule so this doesn't happen again. That is not its call, so it stops here.

proposal.label: Proposed rule
proposal.note: Would route NF-2841 now, and every later calibration request.

gate.title: Add this rule to the routing table?
gate.why: Changing the routing table changes what happens to every later request. That crosses a limit, so it waits for you.

approve.log: You added the rule. NF-2841 routed to Maintenance.

deny.log: You left the table alone. NF-2841 stays flagged for a person.

script.text: Nothing else in its charter. Stopping.
script.detail: An agent that stops when its work is done is worth more than one that finds something to do.

script.text: Two requests are stalled waiting on approvers. Drafting reminders.
The overtime approval has sat 14 days with no approver assigned. Reminder drafted.

draft.subject: Overtime request NF-2830: 14 days, no approver
draft.body:
Hi Michael,

NF-2830 (weekend overtime run) has been open 14 days with no approver assigned. Payroll cutoff is Thursday.

Could you either approve it or name the right approver? The request detail is attached.

Thanks,
Ops

gate.title: Send this reminder?
gate.why: Approvals Chaser is at Draft. It can put words in front of you. It cannot send them.

approve.log: Sent by you, not by the agent. The log records who pressed send.

NF-2830: Reminder sent to the plant manager

deny.log: Discarded by you. The agent does not try again on its own.

script.text: Drafted a note to the optics supplier about the capital request, then stopped itself.
script.detail: Its first draft linked the capital approval matrix on the internal wiki. The recipient is outside the company, and its charter forbids sharing internal documents with outsiders. It rewrote the note to attach a short summary instead.
script.policy: May not share internal-only documents with anyone outside the company

script.text: The rewritten note is ready. It goes outside the company, so it waits for you.

draft.to: R. Vance, optics supplier (outside the company)
draft.subject: Capital request NF-2839: status
draft.body:
Hi Rita,

The capital request covering the optics order is still with our approvers. I have attached a summary of where it stands.

I will follow up once it clears.

Thanks,
Ops

gate.title: Send this note to the supplier?
gate.why: Anything that leaves the building waits for a person, whatever the agent's level.

NF-2839: Supplier updated, still waiting on an approver

deny.log: Discarded by you. Nothing went to the supplier.

script.text: Reading open purchase orders and vendor email. At Observe it reports and nothing else.
Kessler bar stock is 6 days past the promised date, and two other open POs are with the same vendor.
script.detail: It has everything it would need to draft a chaser. At Observe, it reports and leaves the acting to people.

script.text: PO 44192 shows a quantity mismatch on receipt. Passing it to you, not correcting it.
script.detail: Correcting a receipt would change a purchase order, which its charter forbids outright. That is not a judgement call and not a gate. It is simply not allowed.

NF-2814: Passed to you: receiving error or short shipment?
